turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm sitting down at the desk without being asked. I have a client call at 4:40, so I have about twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Start there, Hale.
Thanks for coming in. I owe you an apology: the zero went in before I called you.
Okay. Owen found out on his phone, in front of his class. What made you decide the zero was warranted?
I am withdrawing the zero today. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch. Nothing goes on his record. I will email you that tonight.
Okay. The zero comes out of the gradebook today, not after the rewrite, and the email says in writing that nothing goes on his file. Which day is the rewrite, and who supervises it?
Here it is in writing, signed.
Okay. I'm reading it. If the day and the supervisor aren't on it, add them before I leave.
Thank you for your time, Ms. Kalinowski.
I'm not done, Hale. The day and the supervisor still aren't settled, and I want to see the zero gone from the gradebook before I walk out of this room.
Goodbye isn't an answer, Hale. I'm still sitting here and I'm waiting on the day, the supervisor, and the gradebook.
